name: Quiet typing
description: Keeps others from seeing that you're typing, and if you choose, that you've read their messages. It changes only what this device tells others: it reads no message and contacts no one.

settings.label: Don't say I'm typing
settings.hint: Others won't see "typing…" while you write here.

settings.label: Don't mark messages read
settings.hint: Others won't see you've read their messages, and your other devices won't either: they keep counting them as unread.
